body.statement:
Fix \(\gamma\in(1/2,1)\) and \(1\le s\le\infty\).  For every sequence \(N\to\infty\), radii \(0<a_N<1\) and \(b_N>0\) satisfying \(a_Nb_N=o((\log N)^{-1/2})\), and arbitrary fixed supplied source fits \((\bar g_N,\bar q_N)\) that are uniformly bounded on the source covariate support, the recentered moment-matched Gaussian construction used to prove Theorem 3.2 of Jin, Mackey, and Syrgkanis supplies two fuzzy priors \(\Pi_{0,N}\) and \(\Pi_{1,N}\).  The lower-bound constant below is uniform over the recentering pair.  Let
\[
 \mathfrak F_N(a_N,b_N;\bar g_N,\bar q_N)
 =\operatorname{supp}(\Pi_{0,N})\cup
   \operatorname{supp}(\Pi_{1,N}).
\]
Every \(R\in\mathfrak F_N(a_N,b_N;\bar g_N,\bar q_N)\) satisfies
\[
 T=g_R(X)+\eta_R,\qquad
 Y=\vartheta(R)T+f_R(X)+\xi_R,
\]
\[
 \eta_R\sim\mathcal N(0,1),\qquad
 \eta_R\perp X,\qquad
 E_R[\xi_R\mid X,T]=0,
\]
and \(q_R(x)=E_R[Y\mid X=x]\).  Its treatment and outcome regressions satisfy
\[
 \|g_R-\bar g_N\|_{L^s(R_X)}\le a_N,
 \qquad
 \|q_R-\bar q_N\|_{L^s(R_X)}\le b_N.
\]
Moreover, there is \(c_\gamma>0\), independent of the estimator, such that for every estimator \(\widehat\vartheta\) based on the \(N\) observations there is a law \(R\in\mathfrak F_N(a_N,b_N;\bar g_N,\bar q_N)\) for which
\[
 R^N\!\left\{
 |\widehat\vartheta-\vartheta(R)|
 \ge c_\gamma\left[
 N^{-1/2}+a_Nb_N
 \left\{\frac{\log(1/a_N)}{\log N}\right\}^{3}
 \right]
 \right\}\ge\gamma.
\]
Thus the bad-law witness belongs to the displayed union of the supports of the particular fuzzy priors, rather than merely to an unspecified larger source class.

source.locator: Theorem 3.2, equation (6), with the two fuzzy priors and their supports constructed in Section D, especially construction (44) and equations (55)--(58)
